desc: Implement factorial precomputation and modular inverse for $W_j = (N-1-j)! j!$.
Count numbers and sum their values for each digit length $L \in \{1, \dots, 6\}$.
Compute the full DP table $DP_{full}[j]$ for the multiset of all digit lengths using NTT-based polynomial exponentiation.
For each digit length $L$, compute the modified DP table $DP_L$ by removing one instance of length $L$ from $DP_{full}$.
For each digit length $L$, compute the weighted sum $Term_L = \sum W_j DP_L[j]$ and accumulate $SumVal[L] \cdot Term_L$ to the result.
